other.general_negative.title: Generic negative reviews without specific problem
other.general_negative.description: Reviews are brief, broad complaints about the app, its support, or a recent update, with little detail on what specifically failed.
other.general_negative.note: Mixes general dissatisfaction with update complaints, support rudeness, and boycott over an unrelated political issue.

usability.other.title: Removed basic player features after update
usability.other.description: Customers say a recent update removed basic controls like skipping, going back, and replaying, and that ads play heavily, making the app feel useless.

playback.other.title: Voice assistant and playback control failures
playback.other.description: Customers report the Google Assistant plays playlists without audio, basic features require payment, and music adjustment does not work properly.
playback.other.note: Mixes voice assistant playback failure, paywalled basic features, and a music adjustment bug.

usability.queue_playlist.title: Cannot control queue or playlist order
usability.queue_playlist.description: Customers say playlists play songs randomly and they cannot skip, queue, or pick specific tracks as expected.

playback.crash_or_wont_open.title: App crashes or will not open
playback.crash_or_wont_open.description: After an update, customers say the app crashes, cannot be opened, or gets stuck on the loading logo screen.

usability.ads.title: Too many loud ads
usability.ads.description: Customers say the app shows too many ads, some of them loud, and they do not want to pay for premium to avoid them.

billing.premium_only_feature.title: Basic features now require premium
billing.premium_only_feature.description: Customers say features such as choosing specific songs or skipping are now locked behind a premium subscription, which they consider unfair.

billing.other.title: Asked to pay for basic music choices
billing.other.description: Customers ask why premium is needed just to choose or play the next song, and one reviewer insults the company's pricing.
billing.other.note: Mixes a pricing question about basic song choice with an abusive insult unrelated to a specific problem.

catalog.lyrics.title: Lyrics missing or inconsistently shown
catalog.lyrics.description: Customers report that lyrics appear for some songs but not others, or do not show at all, making the feature confusing.

catalog.recommendations.title: Unwanted recommendations clutter playlists
catalog.recommendations.description: Customers want playlists without recommendation prompts and feel recommendations have gotten worse than before.
catalog.recommendations.note: Mixes complaints about unwanted recommendation prompts with a sense that recommendation quality declined.

access.other.title: Cannot log in and too many ads
access.other.description: One customer says the app will not let them into their account and also complains about excessive ads.
access.other.note: Mixes a login failure with a complaint about excessive ads.

access.password_reset.title: Password rejected at login
access.password_reset.description: A customer reports the app will not accept their password when signing in.

downloads.offline_mode.title: Offline mode does not work
downloads.offline_mode.description: A customer reports that offline playback is not working.

downloads.other.title: Downloads stuck in background
downloads.other.description: A customer says song downloads keep getting stuck in the background until they reopen Spotify.

playback.connection_error.title: Cannot connect to internet over Wi-Fi
playback.connection_error.description: A customer reports the app is unable to connect to the internet when using Wi-Fi.

billing.charges_refunds.title: Update made everything premium-only
billing.charges_refunds.description: A customer says a recent update put most features behind premium, making the app useless to them.

catalog.other.title: Song library missing tracks
catalog.other.description: A customer says many songs they expect are not available in the app.

playback.stops_or_pauses.title: Playback stops and does not resume correctly
playback.stops_or_pauses.description: A customer says music keeps stopping partway and does not return to where it stopped, instead starting a new song.
